source_note: SHA-256 pins checked-out bytes copied into fixtures. Canonical Git blobs establish source equality across refs. default.json has eol=crlf by repository attributes; this is not a runtime edit.
project_version_delta:
diff --git a/app/project.godot b/app/project.godot
index 7e66d58b..88177f83 100644
--- a/app/project.godot
+++ b/app/project.godot
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@ config_version=5
 config/name="OpenRC Simulator"
 ; UI-04a: numeric x.y.z only (Windows and macOS version fields take integers). The full identity (tag, commits,
 ; SHA, dirty) is res://build_info.json, written into the pack at export. export.sh checks the tag's x.y.z matches.
-config/version="0.2.8"
+config/version="0.2.9"
 ; The lightweight brand entrance hands off to app_root, which owns route selection.
 run/main_scene="res://ui/startup.tscn"
 boot_splash/show_image=false

scope: Headless source/component and bounded accepted-session evidence; no GPU/native/frame-time/release-package qualification.
